state.paragraph: Early in the day on December 12, 2014, the Buyer Group requested permission to work more closely with Longview in order to include a rollover of a portion of the Company shares managed by Longview in the Buyer Group's bid. The Buyer Group informed J.P. Morgan that the Buyer Group was working to achieve a higher price, and that Longview participation with the Buyer Group might enhance the Buyer Group's ability to do so. Bidder 2 indicated to J.P. Morgan that accommodation of a Longview rollover would not affect Bidder 2's price, and that Bidder 2 would consider accommodating a Longview rollover only after execution of a merger agreement between the Company and Bidder 2. After consultation with the Company's financial and legal advisors, the ad hoc committee approved the Buyer Group's request, and,

ledger_rows.Note: Final bid letter with revised merger agreement and transaction documents. Financing commitment documents supplied 12/06. Documents less conditional than Bidder 2’s. Not dependent on Longview rollover.

Final bid letter with revised merger agreement and transaction documents; documents more conditional than Buyer Group’s; financing status not reported until 12/12. Would partner with Longview only after signing.
Final-bid due date (evening). Two written bids received; Bidder 3 gave only a verbal valuation.
Verbal valuation not above the ~$78 stock price; J.P. Morgan said it was unlikely to be competitive, so no written offer. Both sides contributed. Not mentioned again.
Neither bid acceptable unless improved: J.P. Morgan told both bidders to raise their bids, improved bids due 12/12. Treated as an extension within the final round, not a new round.

Rollover permitted: committee approved Buyer Group’s request to work with Longview; confidentiality agreement shared bid price. Bidder 2 would consider rollover only post-signing. Both bidders met Longview 12/09 without disclosing prices.
Revises #30. Confirmed to J.P. Morgan as best and final; with revised merger agreement drafts and financing commitment documents.
Revises #29. Oral offer; said it was working to raise it within hours. Financing commitments already provided.

Revises #36. Best and final; revised drafts “with few exceptions” in executable form, plus financing commitments. Longview’s $250 million rollover support helped reach $83.00; members unwilling or unable to go higher.
Due date for improved bids; both remaining bidders submitted that evening.
Board selected Buyer Group: approved merger at $83.00 cash, subject to resolving remaining open points in the agreement; J.P. Morgan gave fairness opinion.

$83.00 per share in cash. Parent Argos Holdings (BC Partners-affiliated). Equity up to $1.83bn plus Longview rollover (3,012,050 shares, $250m); debt up to $6.95bn (Citi-led); Longview voting agreement. No go-shop.
Press release announcing the transaction on the signing date.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
